    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self._seq = 0
        self._last_fulfilled = None
    def begin(self, query):
        # increments sequence id for each new request
        self._seq += 1
        # clear previous loading errors but keep rows
        self.error = None
        # mark loading true until a valid finish arrives
        self.loading = True
        return self._seq
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        # Only the latest begun request can update rows, once
        if request_id != self._seq:
            return False
        if self._last_fulfilled == request_id:
            return False
        # accept rows (make a shallow copy to avoid external mutation)
        self.rows = list(rows)
        # mark this request as fulfilled
        self._last_fulfilled = request_id
        # loading complete for this request
        self.loading = False
        return True
